The main screen around a mount: an unlock the form did not start shows as in progress on the form's button, a tap and a second request do not start another, and the partition mounts once. Manage backups is below the form and the bell left of Settings. The mount opens the slider on Drives; Back, Close and a drag close it, the top bar icon and a swipe to the left reopen it, Backups lists nothing. A wide screen keeps its pane with the same tabs.
